_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وكُلُّ قَوِيٍّ غَيرُهُ ضَعيفٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘And every strong person besides Allah is weak.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ شَيءٍ خاشِعٌ لَهُ ، وكُلُّ شَيءٍ قائمٌ بِهِ ، غِنى كُلِّ فَقيرٍ ، وعِزُّ كُلِّ ذَليلٍ ، وقُوَّةُ كلِّ ضَعيفٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Everything humbles before Him, and everything subsists through Him. He is the contentment of every poor, the honour of every disgraced one, and the strength of every weak one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ عَزيزٍ غَيرُهُ ذَليلٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Every mighty one besides Him is abased.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الحَمدُ للّهِ الّذي لَبِسَ العِزَّ والكِبرِياءَ، واختارَهُما لِنَفسِهِ دُونَ خَلقِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Praise be to Allah who wears the cloak of might and majesty, and has chosen them for Himself over the rest of His creation.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ: وكَيفَ لا يُسألُ عَمّا يَفعَلُ؟ ـ: لِأنَّهُ لا يَفعَلُ إلّا ما كانَ حِكمَةً وصَواباً.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) was once asked why it is that Allah cannot be questioned about what He does, to which he replied, ‘Because He only does what is wise and good.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الصَّمَدُ: الّذي لا جَوفَ لَهُ ، والصَّمَدُ: الّذي قَدِ انتَهى سُؤدَدُهُ ، والصَّمَدُ الّذي لا يَأكُلُ ولا يَشرَبُ ، والصَّمَدُ: الّذي لا يَنامُ ، والصَّمَدُ: الدّائمُ الّذي لَم يَزَلْ ولا يَزالُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘The All-embracing is the One Who has no lack within Him; the All-embracing is the One Whose mastership is complete; the All-embracing is the One Who neither eats nor drinks; the All-embracing is the One Who does not sleep; the All-embracing is the Eternal One who is and will always be.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في صِفَةِ اللّهِ سُبحانَهُ ـ: وإنَّهُ لَبِكُلِّ مَكانٍ ، وفي كُلِّ حِينٍ وأوانٍ ، ومَعَ كُلِّ إنسٍ وجانٍّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, describing Allah, Glory be to Him, ‘And verily He is everywhere, each and every moment and time, and with every human and Jinn.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لَمّا سُئلَ عَن قَولِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وجلَّ: «وهُوَ اللّهُ في السَّماواتِ وفي الأرضِ» ـ: كذلِكَ هُوَ في كُلِّ مَكانٍ . قُلتُ: بِذاتِه ؟ قالَ: وَيحَكَ ! إنَّ الأماكِنَ أقدارٌ ، فإذا قُلتَ: في مَكانٍ بِذاتِهِ لَزِمَكَ أن تَقولَ: في أقدارٍ وغَيرِ ذلكَ ، ولكِنْ هُوَ بائنٌ مِن خَلقِهِ ، مُحيطٌ بِما خَلَقَ عِلماً وقُدرَةً وإحاطَةً وسُلطاناً ومُلكاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was asked by Abu Jauafar regarding Allahs verse in the Quran: “And He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth”, to which he replied, ‘Yes, similarly He is in every place. I [Abu Jaafar] asked, ‘In His essence? Imam replied, ‘Woe betide you! Verily places are the objects of divine decree, so by your saying that He is in a place in essence, you are in fact compelled to say that He is both in the objects of His divine decree and separate thereof. He is, however, distinct from His creation, entirely encompassing what He creates in knowledge, power, control, authority and dominion.

_source.chapter: Attributes of His Essence and Attributes of His Action
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَبُّنا نورِيُّ الذّاتِ ، حَيُّ الذّاتِ، عالِمُ الذّاتِ، صَمَدِيُّ الذّاتِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Our Lord is luminant in His very essence, Living in His very essence, All-knowing in His very essence, All-embracing in His very essence.

_source.chapter: Attributes of His Essence and Attributes of His Action
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المَشيئَةُ والإرادَةُ مِن صِفاتِ الأفعالِ، فمَن زَعَمَ أنَّ اللّهَ تَعالى لَم يَزَلْ مُريداً شائياً فلَيسَ بِمُوَحِّدٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘Wish and will are among the attributes of Allahs action, so whoever claims that Allah, most High, is eternally willing and wishing has not understood His divine unity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوَّلُ الدِّينِ مَعرِفَتُهُ ، وكمالُ مَعرِفَتِهِ التَّصديقُ بِهِ ، وكمالُ التَّصديقِ بِهِ تَوحيدُهُ ، وكَمالُ تَوحيدِهِ الإخلاصُ لَهُ ، وكمالُ الإخلاصِ لَهُ نَفيُ الصِّفاتِ عَنهُ ؛ لِشَهادَةِ كُلِّ صِفَةٍ أنَّها غَيرُ المَوصوفِ ، وشَهادَةِ كُلِّ مَوصوفٍ أنَّهُ غَيرُ الصِّفَةِ ، فمَن وَصَفَ اللّهَ سُبحانَهُ فقَد قَرَنَهُ ، ومَن قَرَنَهُ فقَد ثَنّاهُ ، ومَن ثنّاهُ فَقَد جَزَّأهُ ، ومَن جَزَّأهُ فقَد جَهِلَهُ ، (ومَن جَهِلَهُ فقَد أشارَ إلَيهِ) ، ومَن أشارَ إلَيهِ فقَد حَدَّهُ ، ومَن حَدَّهُ فقَد عَدَّهُ ، ومَن قالَ: «فيمَ ؟» فقَد ضَمَّنَهُ ، ومَن قالَ: «عَلامَ ؟» فقَد أخلى مِنهُ ، كائنٌ لا عَن حَدَثٍ ، مَوجودٌ لا عَن عَدَمٍ ، مَعَ كُلِّ شَيءٍ لا بِمُقارَنَةٍ ، وغَيرُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ لا بِمُزايَلَةٍ ، فاعِلٌ لا بِمَعنَى الحَرَكاتِ والآلَةِ ، بَصيرٌ إذ لا مَنظورَ إلَيهِ مِن خَلقِهِ ، مُتَوحِّدٌ إذ لا سَكَنَ يَستَأنِسُ بِهِ ولا يَستَوحِشُ لِفَقدِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The very first step in religion is acknowledging Him, and the perfect way to acknowledge Him is to testify to Him, and the perfect way to testify to Him is to believe in His divine unity, and the perfect way to believe in His divine unity is to regard Him as absolutely pure, and the perfect way to regard Him as absolutely pure is to negate all attributes from Him, for every attribute is a proof of its own distinction from the thing to which it is attributed, and everything that is attached and attributed is distinct from the attribute. Thus, whoever attaches attributes to Allah, Glory be to Him, associates Him with something else, and whoever associates Him regards Him as two, and whoever regards Him as two identifies parts to Him, and whoever identifies parts to Him has indeed misunderstood Him, and whoever misunderstands Him singles Him out, and whoever singles Him out has confined Him, and whoever confines Him has enumerated Him. Whoever asks ‘In what [is He]? holds that He is contained, and whoever asks ‘On what [is He]? has excluded Him. He is [a Being] but not through any phenomenon of coming into being, He exists but not from non-existence. He is with everything but not in physical proximity, and is separate from everything but not through physical separation. He acts but without need for movements and instruments. He sees without need for an object of sight from among His creation. He is One such that He has no need for a source of comfort that may keep Him company nor any whom He may miss in his absence.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : شَرُّ الاُمورِ مُحْدَثاتُها ، ألاَ وكُلُّ بِدعةٍ ضلالةٌ، ألاَ وكلُّ ضَلالةٍ ففي النّارِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The worst of matters are the innovations. Certainly, every innovation is a [source of] error and every error is destined for Hell.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إيّاكَ أنْ تَسُنَّ سُنّةَ بدعةٍ ؛ فإنَّ العبدَ إذا سَنَّ سُنّةً سيّئةً لَحِقَهُ وِزْرُها ووِزْرُ مَن عَمِلَ بها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Never start a practice based on an innovation; for a man who initiates a bad practice will incur its sin and the sins of the people who imitate him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما اُحْدِثَتْ بِدعةٌ إلّا تُرِكَ بها سُنّةٌ ، فاتّقوا البِدعَ والْزَموا المَهْيَعَ ، إنّ عَوازِمَ الاُمورِ أفضَلُها ، وإنَّ مُحْدَثاتِها شِرارُها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘No sooner is an innovation initiated than it leaves behind a common practice. So eschew innovations and adhere to the clear path. Verily the established traditions are the best, while innovated ones are the worst.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:9, p. 93

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما هَدمَ الدِّينَ مثلُ البِدعِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Nothing destroys religion like innovations.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أهلُ البِدَعِ شَرُّ الخَلقِ والخليقةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The innovators are the worst of all of [Gods] creation.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أهلُ البدعِ كِلابُ أهلِ النّارِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The innovators are the dogs of the inmates of Hell.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أمّا أهلُ البِدعةِ فالمُخالِفونَ لأمرِ اللّهِ ولِكتابهِ ورسولِه ، العاملونَ بِرأيِهم وأهوائهِم وإنْ كَثُروا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The innovators are those who contradict the command of Allah, His Book and His Messenger; they are those who follow their own opinion and desires, even if they are the majority.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن دعا النـّاسَ إلى نفسِه وفيهِم مَن هُو أعلمُ مِنه فهُو مُبْتَدِعٌ ضالٌّ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Anyone who calls people to give him their allegiance, knowing that among them is someone superior to him, is an erroneous innovator.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن أعرَضَ عن صاحِبِ بِدعةٍ ، بُغْضاً لَهُ ، مَلأ اللّهُ قلبَهُ أمْناً وإيماناً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When a man rejects an innovator, out of dislike for him, Allah will fill his heart with peace and belief.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن تَبَسّمَ في وجهِ مُبتَدِعٍ فقد أعانَ على هَدمِ دِينِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A man who smiles at an innovator has aided the destruction of his own religion.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن عمِلَ في بِدعةٍ خَلاّهُ الشّيطانُ والعِبادةَ، وألْقى عليهِ الخُشوعَ والبُكاءَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When a man acts in accordance with an innovation, Satan will leave him to worship and incite tears and emotion in him [i.e. that he may continue in its performance].

_source.chapter: Invalidity Of The Worship Of An Innovator
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : عَملٌ قليلٌ في سُنّةٍ خيرٌ مِن عملٍ كثيرٍ في بِدعةٍ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Little worship following a correct [Prophetic] practice is better than a lot of worship following an innovation.

_source.chapter: Invalidity Of The Worship Of An Innovator
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أبَى اللّهُ لصاحِبِ البدعةِ بالتّوبةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah denies the innovator a chance to repent.

_source.chapter: A Scholars Duties When Faced With The Appearance of Innovations
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إذا ظَهَرتِ البِدعُ في اُمّتي فلْيُظهِرِ العالِمُ علمَهُ ، فمَن لَم يَفعلْ فعَلَيهِ لَعنةُ اللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When innovations arise in my community, the scholar must display his knowledge; and those who do not do this deserve the curse of Allah.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَجِبُ عَلَى العالِمِ عِندَ ظُهورِ البِدَعِ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ليسَ الأعمى مَن يَعْمى بَصرُهُ، إنَّما الأعمى مَن تَعْمى بَصيرتُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The blind is not someone who has lost his eyesight, but the one who has lost his insight.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): نَظَرُ البَصَرِ لا يُجْدي إذا عَمِيَتِ البَصيرةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Eyesight is useless if the insight goes blind.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فإنّما البَصيرُ مَن سمِعَ فتَفَكّرَ، ونَظرَ فأبْصرَ، وانْتَفعَ بالعِبَرِ، ثُمّ سَلَكَ جَدَداً واضِحاً يَتَجنّبُ فيهِ الصَّرْعَةَ في المَهاوِي.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Indeed, the insightful one is he who listens and contemplates, looks and sees, derives benefit from lessons, then he takes a clear path on which he avoids the falls into abysses.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:9. p. 158

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيستِ الرَّوِيَّةُ كَالمُعايَنَةِ مَع الإبْصارِ ؛ فقد تَكذِبُ العُيونُ أهلَها، ولا يَغُشُّ العقلُ مَنِ اسْتَنْصحَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Vision is not dependent on the eyes, for the eyes may often belie their owners, yet the mind never deceives a man seeking its counsel.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:19, p. 173

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَقْدُ البَصرِ أهْوَنُ مِن فِقْدانِ البَصيرةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Losing ones eyesight is easier than losing ones insight.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أبْصَرُ النّاسِ مَن أبْصَرَ عُيوبَهُ وأقْلَعَ عن ذُنوبِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most insightful person is he who sees his own flaws and refrains from sins as a result.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سابُّ المُؤمِنِ كالمُشرِفِ على الهَلَكَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The one who insults a believer is as one who is on the verge of ruin.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سِبابُ المؤمِنِ فُسوقٌ ، وقِتالُهُ كُفرٌ ، وأكلُ لَحمِهِ مِن مَعصيَةِ اللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'To insult a believer is a gross iniquity, to kill him is infidelity, and to backbite him is an act of disobedience of Allah.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَسُبُّوا الرِّياحَ فإنّها مَأمُورَةٌ ، ولا تَسُبُّوا الجِبالَ ولا السّاعاتِ ولا الأيّامَ ولا اللَّيالِيَ فَتَأثَمُوا وتَرجِعَ علَيكُم .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not insult the winds for verily they are commanded [to blow], nor insult the mountains, nor time, nor the days, nor the nights, lest you transgress thereby and it comes back to you.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَسُبُّوا الناسَ فَتَكتَسِبُوا العَداوةَ بَينَهُم .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not insult people lest you procure animosity from them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لِقَنْبرٍ وقد رامَ أن يَشتِمَ شاتِمَهُ ـ: مَهْلاً يا قَنبرُ ! دَعْ شاتِمَكَ مُهاناً تُرْضِ الرَّحمنَ وتُسخِطُ الشَّيطانَ وتُعاقِبُ عَدُوَّكَ ، فَوَالذي فَلَقَ الحَبَّةَ وبَرَأ النَّسَمَةَ ما أرضَى المؤمنُ رَبَّهُ بِمِثلِ الحِلْمِ ، ولا أسخَطَ الشَّيطانَ بِمِثلِ الصَّمتِ ، ولا عُوقِبَ الأحمَقُ بمِثلِ السُّكوتِ عَنهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said to Qanbar when he wished to insult a man who had insulted him, 'Careful Qanbar! Leave your insulter to his disdain and you will please the Beneficent Lord, displease Satan and punish thereby your enemy, for by the One who split the grain and created the breeze, there is no stance better than clemency with which a believer can please his Lord, and nothing like silence to offend Satan, and an idiot is best punished by ignoring him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا رَأى رَجُلَينِ يَتَسابّانِ ـ: البادِي أظلَمُ ، ووِزرُهُ ووِزرُ صاحِبِهِ علَيهِ ما لَم يَعتَدِ المَظلومُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) when he saw two people insulting each other, said, 'The initiator is the more unjust and bears his own sin as well as the sin of his opponent as long as the latter does not retort.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما تَسابَّ اثنانِ إلّا انحَطَّ الأعلى إلى مَرتَبةِ الأسفَلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, 'Whenever two people insult each other, the more superior of the two sinks to the level of the more inferior one.

_source.chapter: The Punishment of One Who Insults the Prophets and the Vicegerents
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه صلى الله عليه و آله : مَن سَبَّ نَبيّا مِنَ الأنبياءِ فاقتُلُوهُ ، ومَن سَبَّ وَصِيّا فقد سَبَّ نبيّا .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever insults any of the prophets, kill him; and he who insults a vicegerent is as one who has insulted a prophet.

_source.chapter: The Punishment of One Who Insults the Prophets and the Vicegerents
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ عليه السلام لَمّا سُئلَ عَمَّن شَتَمَ رسولَ اللّه صلى الله عليه و آله: يَقتُلُهُ الأدنى فَالأدنى قَبْلَ أن يَرفَعَهُ إلى الإمام .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) when he was asked about someone who insulted the Prophet (SAWA), replied, 'The most inferior person [in society] must kill him, and if not him, then the second most inferior, and so on until at the last resort he must be killed by the imam [leader of the congregational prayer].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه صلى الله عليه و آله : إذا شَتَمَ أحَدُكُم أخاهُ فلا يَشتِمْ عَشِيرَتَهُ ، ولا أباهُ ، ولا اُمَّهُ ، ولكنْ لِيَقُلْ إن كانَ يَعلَمُ ذلك : إنّكَ لَبَخِيلٌ ، وإنّكَ لَجَبانٌ ، وإنّكَ لَكَذُوبٌ ، إن كانَ يَعلَمُ ذلكَ مِنهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If any of you ever insults his fellow brother, he must not insult his family or his father or mother. He can only say - if he knows these flaws for certain - 'You are indeed a miser, or you are indeed a coward, or you are indeed a liar' only if he is certain of the existence of these traits.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قِوامُ المَرءِ عَقلُهُ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن لا عَقلَ لَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The very basis of man is his intellect, and the man devoid of intellect has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما استَودَعَ اللّهُ امرَأً عَقلاً إلّا استَنقَذَهُ بِهِ يَوماً ما.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has only assigned man with an intellect so that it may one day deliver him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ أقوى أساسٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is the strongest foundation.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ مُنَزِّهٌ عَنِ المُنكَرِ آمِرٌ بِالمَعروفِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is immune from wrong and commands good-doing.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ مُصلِحُ كُلِّ أمرٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect sets right all matters.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ رُقِيٌّ إلى عِلِّيِّينَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is a ladder upwards towards the AeIlliyyin [the loftiest heavens].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ رَسولُ الحَقِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is the messenger of the truth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ أغنَى الغِنَى العَقلُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the most sufficient of riches is the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ خَليلُ المَرءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is the friend of the believer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا مُصيبَةَ كَعَدَمِ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘There is no affliction worse than a lack of intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ جلَّ ثَناؤهُ خَلَقَ العَقلَ، وهُوَ أوَّلُ خَلقٍ خَلَقَهُ مِنَ الرُّوحانيّينَ عَن يَمينِ العَرشِ مِن نورِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, exalted be His praise, created the intellect, and it is the very first thing He created amongst all the spiritual beings from the right hand side of His Throne out of His Light.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خَلَقَ اللّهُ تَعالى العَقلَ مِن أربَعَةِ أشياءَ: مِنَ العِلمِ ، والقُدرَةِ ، والنّورِ ، والمَشيئَةِ بِالأمرِ ، فجَعَلَهُ قائماً بِالعِلمِ ، دائماً في المَلَكوتِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah created the intellect out of four things from knowledge, power, light and volition. Then He caused it to subsist through knowledge and be eternal in the divine Dominion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا غِنى أخصَبُ مِنَ العَقلِ ، ولا فَقرَ أحَطُّ مِنَ الحُمقِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There is no wealth more productive than the intellect and no poverty lower than stupidity.'

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا مالَ أعوَدُ مِنَ العَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There is no wealth more profiting than the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ دَليلُ المُؤمِنِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The intellect is the authoritative proof of the believer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصِيَّتِهِ لِهِشامِ ابنِ الحَكَمِ ـ: يا هِشامُ ، ما قُسِّمَ بَينَ العِبادِ أفضَلُ مِنَ العَقلِ ؛ نَومُ العاقِلِ أفضَلُ مِن سَهَرِ الجاهِلِ ، وما بَعَثَ اللّهُ نَبِيّاً إلّا عاقِلاً حَتّى يَكونَ عَقلُهُ أفضَلَ مِن جَميعِ جَهدِ المُجتَهِدينَ ، وما أدَّى العَبدُ فَريضَةً مِن فَرائضِ اللّهِ حَتّى عَقَلَ عَنهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS), in his advice to Hisham b. al-Hakam, said, ‘O Hisham, nothing has been bestowed upon the servants better than the intellect. The sleep of a man of intellect is better than the night vigil of an ignorant man. Every single prophet that Allah has sent down has been a man of intellect, whose intellect supercedes the labour of all diligent workers. The servant is not considered as having fulfilled an obligatory act from among the acts made incumbent by Allah until he understands it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صَديقُ كُلِّ امرِئٍ عَقلُهُ وعَدُوُّهُ جَهلُهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘The friend of every man is his intellect and his enemy is his ignorance.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: مجمع البيان: أثنى قومٌ على رجُلٍ عندَ رَسولِ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) فقالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كَيفَ عَقلُ الرَّجُلِ ؟ قالوا: يا رَسولَ اللّهِ، نُخبِرُكَ عَنِ اجتِهادِهِ في العِبادَةِ وأصنافِ الخَيرِ ، وتَسألُنا عَن عَقلِهِ ؟ ! فقالَ: إنَّ الأحمَقَ يُصيبُ بِحُمقِهِ أعظَمَ مِن فُجورِ الفاجِرِ، وإنَّما يَرتَفِعُ العِبادُ غَداً في الدَّرَجاتِ ويَنالونَ الزُّلفى مِن رَبِّهِم عَلى قَدرِ عُقولِهِم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) asked a group of people who were praising a man, ‘How is the man s intellect to which they replied, ‘O Prophet of Allah, we are telling you about his endeavours at worship and other good acts, and you are asking us about his intellect! So he replied, ‘Verily the stupid person suffers as a result of his stupidity worse than the licentiousness of an immoral person. The servants will rise up in rank in the Hereafter and will receive great rewards from their Lord in proportion to their intellects.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّما يُدرَكُ الخَيرُ كُلُّهُ بِالعَقلِ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن لا عَقلَ لَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily all good is grasped through the intellect, and the man devoid of intellect has no religion.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بِالعَقلِ تُدرَكُ الدّارانِ جَميعاً، ومَن حُرِمَ مِنَ العَقلِ حُرِمَهُما جَميعاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Both the abodes [of the world and the Hereafter] are grasped by the intellect, and whoever is deprived of the intellect is deprived of them both.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَمّا خَلَقَ اللّهُ العَقلَ قالَ لَهُ: أقبِلْ فَأقبَلَ ، ثُمَّ قالَ لَهُ: أدبِرْ فَأدبَرَ ، فقالَ: وعِزَّتي وجَلالي ما خَلَقتُ خَلقا أحسَنَ مِنكَ، إيّاكَ آمُرُ وإيّاكَ أنهى ، وإيّاكَ اُثيبُ وإيّاكَ اُعاقِبُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘When Allah created the intellect He said to it, ‘Come forward so it came forward, then commanded it, ‘Go back and it went back. Then He said to it, ‘By my Honour and Exaltedness, I have not created anything better than you. It is you that I command, and you that I prohibit from things, and you that I punish and you that I reward.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِمّا اُوحِيَ إلى موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: أنا اُؤاخِذُ عِبادي عَلى قَدرِ ما أعطَيتُهُم مِنَ العَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrated, ‘Among what was revealed to Moses (AS) was, ‘I take My servants to account according to the level of intellect that I have given them.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وَجَدتُ في الكِتابِ [ يَعني كِتاباً لِعَلِيٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ] أنَّ قيمَةَ كُلِّ امرِئٍ وقَدرَهُ مَعرِفَتُهُ ، إنَّ اللّهَ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى يُحاسِبُ النّاسَ عَلى قَدرِ ما آتاهُم مِنَ العُقولِ في دارِ الدّنيا .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘I found written in the Book [i.e. the Book ascribed to Imam Ali (AS)] that the worth and value of every man is his knowledge. Verily Allah, Blessed and most High, will take people to account according to the intellects that He has given them in this world s life.

_source.chapter: The Role of the Intellect in Chastisement and Reward
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أرادَ الغِنى بِلا مالٍ ، وراحَةَ القَلبِ مِنَ الحَسَدِ ، والسَّلامَةَ في الدِّينِ ، فَلْيَتَضَرَّعْ إلَى اللّهِ عَزَّوجلَّ في مَسألَتِهِ بِأن يُكمِلَ عَقلَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘He who wants wealth without the need for riches, and comfort of the heart free from jealousy, and security in his faith should implore Allah, Mighty and Exalted, in his plea for Him to perfect his intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ للّهِ عَلَى النّاسِ حُجَّتَينِ: حُجَّةً ظاهِرَةً ، وحُجَّةً باطِنَةً ، فأمّا الظّاهِرَةُ فَالرُّسُلُ والأنبِياءُ والأئمَّةُ ^ ، وأمّا الباطِنَةُ فَالعُقولُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah has two authoritative proofs over people a manifest proof and an inward proof. The manifest proof is represented by the prophets and messengers and Imams (AS), and the inward proof is represented by the intellects.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصِيَّتِهِ لِهِشامِ بنِ الحَكَمِ ـ: ما بَعَثَ اللّهُ أنبِياءَهُ ورُسُلَهُ إلى عِبادِهِ إلّا لِيَعقِلوا عَنِ اللّهِ ، فأحسَنُهُمُ استِجابَةً أحسَنُهُم مَعرِفَةً ، وأعلَمُهُم بِأمرِ اللّهِ أحسَنُهُم عَقلاً ، وأكمَلُهُم عَقلاً أرفَعُهُم دَرَجَةً في الدّنيا والآخِرَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) in his advice to Hisham b. al-Hakam, said, ‘Allah has only sent His prophets and messengers to His servants in order that they may come to an understanding of Allah, so the ones who best heed their call are those who have the best inner knowledge, and the ones who know Allah s command the best are those that have the best intellects, and those that have the most perfect intellects will be the ones with the highest status in this world and in the Hereafter.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ العَقلَ عِقالٌ مِنَ الجَهلِ، والنَّفسَ مِثلُ أخبَثِ الدَّوابِّ ، فإن لَم تُعقَلْ حارَت.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the intellect is a lasso used to restrain ignorance, and the carnal soul is like the vilest of beasts which if left unrestrained will go wild.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): العَقلُ نورٌ خَلَقَهُ اللّهُ لِلإنسانِ ، وجَعَلَهُ يُضيءُ عَلَى القَلبِ ؛ لِيَعرِفَ بِهِ الفَرقَ بَينَ المُشاهَداتِ مِنَ المُغَيَّباتِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The intellect is a light that Allah has created for mankind and which He has ordained to illuminate the heart, in order that with it, he may know the difference between the visually manifest things and the unseen things.
_source.cited_from: Aawali al-La ali, volume:1, p. 248, number:4

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ أن تَقولَ ما تَعرِفُ ، وتَعمَلَ بِما تَنطِقُ بِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘[To be a man of] intellect is that you say only that which you know and act upon what you say.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ حِفظُ التَّجارِبِ ، وخَيرُ ما جَرَّبتَ ما وَعَظَكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘[To be a man of] intellect is to preserve your experiences, and the best of all that you have experienced is that which has taught you a lesson.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ عَقلانِ: عَقلُ الطَّبعِ وعَقلُ التَّجرِبَةِ ، وكِلاهُما يُؤَدّي المَنفَعَةَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There are two divisions of intellect the natural intellect and the intellect of experience, and both of them produce benefit.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عَنِ العَقلِ ـ: التَّجَرُّعُ لِلغُصَّةِ حَتّى تَنالَ الفُرصَةَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) when asked about the intellect, said, ‘To suppress one s annoyance until the opportunity arises.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سَألَهُ أبوهُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عَنِ العَقلِ ـ: حِفظُ قَلبِكَ ما استَودَعتَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS), when his father asked him regarding the intellect, said, ‘It is for the heart to safeguard what you have deposited therein.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): صِفَةُ العاقِلِ أن يَحلُمَ عَمَّن جَهِلَ عَلَيهِ ، ويَتَجاوَزَ عَمَّن ظَلَمَهُ ، ويَتَواضَعَ لِمَن هُوَ دونَهُ ، ويُسابِقَ مَن فَوقَهُ في طَلَبِ البِرِّ ، وإذا أرادَ أن يَتَكَلَّمَ تَدَبَّرَ ؛ فإنْ كانَ خَيراً تَكَلَّمَ فغَنِمَ ، وإن كانَ شَرّاً سَكَتَ فسَلِمَ ، وإذا عَرَضَت لَهُ فِتنَةٌ استَعصَمَ بِاللّهِ وأمسَكَ يَدَهُ ولِسانَهُ ، وإذا رَأى فَضيلَةً انتَهَزَ بِها ، لا يُفارِقُه الحَياءُ ، ولا يَبدو مِنهُ الحِرصُ ، فتِلكَ عَشرُ خِصالٍ يُعرَفُ بِها العاقِلُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The attribute of a man of intellect is that he is clement towards one who behaves rashly with him, overlooks the fault of one who wrongs him, is humble even towards one who is lower than him in rank, tries to get ahead of those above him in his quest for good. Whenever he wishes to speak, he contemplates if what he wants to say is good, he says it and benefits as a result, and if it is bad, then he keeps quiet and remains safe as a result. When a temptation arises before him, he holds fast to Allah and guards his hand and his tongue if he sees virtue in it, he seizes it, neither losing his modesty thereat nor displaying any greed. These are ten qualities by which a man of intellect may be known.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أعقَلُ النّاسِ أشَدُّهُم مُداراةً لِلنّاسِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The most intelligent of people is he who is best at dealing with people.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صَدرُ العاقِلِ صُندوقُ سِرِّهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The chest of a man of intellect is the strongbox of his secret.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: نهج البلاغة: قيل له [ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ]: صِف لنا العاقل ، فقال: هُوَ الّذي يَضَعُ الشَّيءَ مَواضِعَهُ . فقيلَ: فَصِفْ لَنا الجاهِلَ ، فقالَ: قَد فَعَلتُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) was asked to describe a man of intellect, to which he replied, ‘He is the one who puts things in their place. The he was asked, ‘So describe to us the ignorant man, to which he replied, ‘I have already done so.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يُلسَعُ العاقِلُ مِن جُحرٍ مَرَّتَينِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The man of intellect is never stung twice from the same hive.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الكافي عن بَعضِ أصحابِنا رَفَعَهُ إلَى الإمامِ الصّادقِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قلتُ لهُ: مَا العقلُ؟ قالَ: ما عُبِدَ بِهِ الرَّحمنُ وَاكتُسِبَ بِهِ الجِنانُ . قالَ: قُلتُ: فَالّذي كانَ في مُعاوِيَةَ ؟ فقالَ: تِلكَ النَّكراءُ ، تِلكَ الشَّيطَنَةُ ، وهِيَ شَبيهَةٌ بِالعَقلِ ولَيسَت بِالعَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was asked what the intellect was, to which he replied, ‘It is that with which The Beneficent God is worshipped and with which Paradise is attained. So the man asked, ‘So what about that which even Muawiya possessed He replied, ‘That is a vicious thing, that is devilry, and resembles intellect, though it is not intellect.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَى العاقِلِ أن يَكونَ عارِفا بِزَمانِهِ ، مُقبِلاً عَلى شَأنِهِ ، حافِظا لِلِسانِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The man of intellect must be well aware of the times he lives in, attentive of his affairs and guarding of his tongue.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ العاقِلَ لا يُحَدِّثُ مَن يَخافُ تَكذيبَهُ ، ولا يَسألُ مَن يَخافُ مَنعَهُ ، ولا يَعِدُ ما لا يَقدِرُ عَلَيهِ ، ولا يَرجو ما يُعَنَّفُ بِرَجائهِ ، ولا يَتَقَدَّمُ عَلى ما يَخافُ العَجزَ عَنهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Verily the man of intellect never talks to one whom he fears will belie him, nor asks of one whom he fears will deny him, nor promises that which he is not able to fulfil, nor hopes for that which will dash his hopes, nor attempts to advance towards that which he fears he will be incapable of reaching.

_source.chapter: The Attributes of a Man of Intellect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ العاقِلَ رَضِيَ بِالدُّونِ مِنَ الدّنيا مَعَ الحِكمَةِ ، ولَم يَرضَ بِالدُّونِ مِنَ الحِكمَةِ مَعَ الدّنيا ؛ فَلِذلكَ رَبِحَت تِجارَتُهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Verily the man of intellect contents himself with less worldly things when accompanied with wisdom, and does not content himself with less wisdom and more worldly things, and this is why their trade [of the transient for the permanent] profits them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ غَريزَةٌ تَزيدُ بِالعِلمِ والتَّجارِبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is an intrinsic thing that increases with knowledge and experiences.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بِتَركِ ما لا يَعنيكَ يَتِمُّ لَكَ العَقلُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘By abandoning that which does not concern you, your intellect will be completed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا تَذاكَروا العَقلَ عِندَ مُعاوِيَةَ ـ: لا يَكمُلُ العَقلُ إلّا بِاتِّباعِ الحَقِّ ، فقالَ مُعاوِيَةُ: ما في صُدورِكُم إلّا شَيءٌ واحِدٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS), when he reminded Muawiya of [the use of] his intellect, said, ‘The intellect is only perfected through following the truth, to which Muawiya replied, ‘There is only one thing in your chests [i.e. you attribute everything to the truth].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَثرَةُ النَّظَرِ في العِلمِ يَفتَحُ العَقلَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Frequent study of matters of knowledge opens the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَثرَةُ النَّظَرِ في الحِكمَةِ تَلقَحُ العَقلَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Frequent study of matters of wisdom fertilizes the intellect.'

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ألا وإنَّ مِن عَلاماتِ العَقلِ التَّجافي عَن دارِ الغُرورِ ، والإنابَةُ إلى دارِ الخُلودِ ، والتَّزَوُّدُ لِسُكنَى القُبورِ ، والتَّأهُّبُ لِيَومِ النُّشورِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Indeed among the signs of intellect are withdrawal from the Abode of Delusion [i.e. this worldly life] and frequenting instead the Abode of Eternity, making provisions for the sojourn in the graves and preparation for the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يُستَدَلُّ عَلى عَقلِ كُلِّ امرِئٍ بِما يَجري عَلى لِسانِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect of every man can be determined by the words that flow on his tongue.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَسولُكَ تَرجُمانُ عَقلِكَ ، وكِتابُكَ أبلَغُ ما يَنطِقُ عَنكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Your messenger is the interpreter of your intellect, and your letter is more eloquent at expressing your true self.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سِتَّةٌ تُختَبَرُ بِها عُقولُ النَّاسِ: الحِلمُ عِندَ الغَضَبِ ، والصَّبرُ عِندَ الرَّهَبِ ، والقَصدُ عِندَ الرَّغَبِ ، وتَقوى اللّهِ في كُلِّ حالٍ ، وحُسنُ المُداراةِ ، وقِلَّةُ المُماراةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There are six things by which people s intellects may be tested clemency at the time of anger, patience at the time of fear, calculation when faced with a desire, Godwariness at all times, amicableness, and minimal engagement in disputation.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سِتَّةٌ تُختَبَرُ بِها عُقولُ الرِّجالِ: المُصاحَبَةُ ، والمُعامَلَةُ ، والوِلايَةُ ، والعَزلُ ، والغِنى ، والفَقرُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There are six things by which men s intellects may be tested the company they keep, their dealings, where their allegiance lies, their disassociation from people, their wealth and their poverty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عِندَ بَديهَةِ المَقالِ تُختَبَرُ عُقولُ الرِّجالِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘People s intellects can be tested when they speak impulsively.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَأيُ الرَّجُلِ ميزانُ عَقلِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man s opinion is the measure of his intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَثرَةُ الصَّوابِ تُنبِئُ عَن وُفورِ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The abundance of reason is an indication of flourishing intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا تَمَّ العَقلُ نَقَصَ الكَلامُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When intellect is complete speech decreases.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كَمُلَ عَقلُهُ استَهانَ بِالشَّهَواتِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He whose intellect is perfected regards carnal desires with disdain.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذَهابُ العَقلِ بَينَ الهَوى والشَّهوَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect disappears between the whims and the carnal desires.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ضَياعُ العُقولِ في طَلَبِ الفُضولِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The loss of the intellect occurs in the quest for all that is superfluous.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إعجابُ المَرءِ بِنَفسِهِ دَليلٌ عَلى ضَعفِ عَقلِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Man s admiration and satisfaction with himself is a proof of his weak intellect.
_source.cited_from: Kanz al-Fawa id li al-Karajiki, volume:1, p. 200

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن صَحِبَ جاهِلاً نَقَصَ مِن عَقلِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever keeps the company of an ignorant man incurs a loss in his intellect.
_source.cited_from: Kanz al-Fawa id li al-Karajiki, volume:1, p. 199

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما مَزَحَ امرُؤٌ مَزحَةً إلّا مَجَّ مِنَ عَقلِه مَجَّةً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whenever a man cracks a joke, a part of his intellect trickles away.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَرَكَ الاستِماعَ مِن ذَوي العُقولِ ماتَ عَقلُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who abandons listening to intellectual people, his own intellect dies.'
_source.cited_from: Kanz al-Fawa id li al-Karajiki, volume:1, p. 199

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما دَخَلَ قَلبَ امرِئٍ شَيءٌ مِنَ الكِبرِ إلّا نَقَصَ مِن عَقلِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘No sooner does an iota of pride enter a man s heart than he incurs a loss in his intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا قَلَّتِ العُقولُ كَثُرَ الفُضولُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When intellect is little, superfluity thrives.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَلَّ عَقلُهُ ساءَ خِطابُهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He whose intellect is weak has bad oratory.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن عَدَمِ العَقلِ مُصاحَبَةُ ذَوي الجَهلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Evidence of lack of intellect is keeping company with ignorant people.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَثرَةُ الأماني مِن فَسادِ العَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Overly high aspirations are a result of a corrupt intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثَمَرَةُ العَقلِ الاستِقامَةُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fruit of the intellect is steadfastness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثَمَرَةُ العَقلِ لُزومُ الحَقِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fruit of the intellect is adherence to the truth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثَمَرَةُ العَقلِ مَقتُ الدّنيا ، وقَمعُ الهَوى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fruit of the intellect is contempt for this worldly life and repression of one s whims.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): العَقلُ شَجَرَةٌ ، ثَمَرُها السَّخاءُ والحَياءُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intellect is a tree the fruit of which is generosity and modesty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الهَوى عَدُوُّ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The caprice is the intellect's adversary.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَم مِن عَقلٍ أسيرٍ تَحتَ هَوى أميرٍ!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Many a slavish mind is subservient to an overpowering caprice!

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَرَضَ اللّهُ... تَركَ شُربِ الخَمرِ تَحصيناً لِلعَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has imposed … the abandonment of drinking alcohol in order to safeguard the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِعلَموا أنَّ الأمَلَ يُسهي العَقلَ ، ويُنسي الذِّكرَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Know that entertaining high hopes distracts the intellect and causes one to forget their remembrance [of Allah].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الهَوى يَقظانٌ والعَقلُ نائمٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The caprice is awake while the intellect is asleep.

_source.chapter: Intercession in the Life of this World
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِشفَعُوا تُؤجَرُوا.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Intercede for someone and you will be rewarded.

_source.chapter: Intercession in the Life of this World
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن شَفَعَ شَفاعَةً يَدفَعُ بها مَغرَماً أو يُحيِي بها مَغنَماً، ثَبَّتَ اللّهُ تعالى قَدَمَيهِ حِينَ تَدحَضُ الأقدامُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever intercedes for someone settling thereby a financial liability or procuring someone's due profit, Allah will give him a firm footing on the day that feet will stumble.

_source.chapter: Intercession in the Life of this World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشَّفاعَةُ زَكاةُ الجاهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Intercession is the zakat of high rank.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): شَفاعَتي لاُِمَّتي مَن أحَبَّ أهلَ بَيتي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'My intercession will avail those people from my community who love my household.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَأشفَعَنَّ يَومَ القِيامَةِ لِمَن كانَ في قَلبِهِ جَناحُ بَعوضَةٍ إيمانٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'On the Day of Resurrection, I will surely intercede for anyone who harbours even a fly's wing's worth of faith in his heart.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا قُمتُ المَقامَ المَحمودَ تَشَفَّعتُ في أصحابِ الكبائرِ مِن اُمَّتي، فَيُشَفِّعُني اللّهُ فِيهِم ، واللّهِ لا تَشَفَّعتُ فِيمَن آذى ذُرِّيَّتي .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'When I stand at the Glorious Station, I will intercede on behalf of those of my community who have perpetrated grave sins, and Allah will accept my intercession for them. By Allah, I will not intercede for anyone who hurts my progeny.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعوَةٌ قد دَعا بِها وقد سَألَ سُؤلاً، وقد خَبَأتُ دَعوَتي لِشَفاعَتِي لاُِمَّتي يَومَ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Every prophet was given the right to a special request which they asked [from Allah], but I suppressed my request in return for the permission to intercede for my community on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولِهِ تعالى: «ولَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضى» ـ: الشَّفاعَةُ ، واللّهِ الشَّفاعةُ ، واللّهِ الشَّفاعَةُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said with regards to Allahs verse in the Quran [addressing the Prophet (SAW)]: “Soon your Lord will give you [that with which] you will be pleased”‘(This is) intercession, by Allah it is intercession, by Allah it is intercession.
_source.cited_from: Quran 93:5, Bihar al-Anwar, volume:8, p. 57, number:72

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى: « لا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفاعَةَ إلّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحمنِ عَهْدا» ـ: إلّا مَن اُذِنَ لَهُ بِوَلايَةِ أميرِ المؤمنينَ والأئمَّةِ مِن بَعدِهِ فهُو العَهدُ عندَ اللّهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said with regards to Allahs verse in the Quran: "No one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent", ‘[This means] except for him who has been allowed intercession through his acceptance of the guardianship of the Commander of the Faithful, Ali (AS) and the Imams after him, as this is the covenant with Allah.

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): رَجُلانِ لا تَنالُهُما شَفاعَتي: صاحِبُ سُلطانٍ عَسُوفٌ غَشُومٌ ، وغالٍ في الدِّينِ مارِقٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Two types of people will not be included in my intercession: the tyrannical and iniquitous ruler and the heretical extremist in matters of religion.

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أمّا شَفاعَتِي ففي أصحابِ الكبائرِ ما خَلا أهلَ الشِّركِ والظُّلمِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘My intercession is intended for those who have committed grave sins [from among the Muslims], except for those guilty of polytheism and injustice to others.

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يَنالُ شَفاعَتي مَنِ استَخَفَّ بِصلاتِهِ ، ولا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ الحَوضَ لا واللّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who does not take his daily prayers seriously will neither benefit from my intercession nor meet me at the Heavenly Pool [of Kawthar], no by Allah.

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن لم يُؤمِنْ بِشَفاعَتِي فلا أنالَهُ اللّهُ شَفاعَتِي .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘My intercession on behalf of one who does not believe in my intercession will not be accepted by Allah.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:1, p. 136, number:35

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا أمَرَ بِاجتِماعِ قَرابَتِهِ حَولَهُ وقد حَضَرَتهُ الوَفاةُ ـ: إنَّ شَفاعَتَنا لَن تَنالَ مُستَخِفّاً بِالصَّلاةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when he asked for his relatives to be gathered around him as his death approached, said to them, ‘Verily our intercession will not avail one who takes his prayer lightly.

_source.chapter: Those Who Will Be Deprived of Intercession
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَو أنَّ المَلائكَةَ المُقَرَّبِينَ والأنبياءَ المُرسَلِينَ شَفَعُوا في ناصِبٍ ما شُفِّعُوا .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Even if the most favoured angels and all the prophets were to intercede for a Nasibi, their intercession would not be accepted.

_source.chapter: Peoples Need for Intercession From the First to the Last
_source.arabic: الإمام الباقرِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد قالَ لَهُ أبو أيمنَ: يا أبا جعفرٍ، تَغُرُّونَ الناسَ وتَقولونَ: شَفاعَةُ محمّدٍ، شَفاعَةُ محمّدٍ! فَغَضِبَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) حتّى تَرَبَّدَ وَجهُهُ ـ: وَيحَكَ يا أبا أيمَنَ ! أغَرَّكَ إن عَفَّ بَطْنُكَ وفَرجُكَ ؟! أما لَو قد رَأيتَ أفزاعَ القِيامَةِ لقدِ احتَجتَ إلى شَفاعَةِ محمّدٍ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، وَيلَكَ فَهل يَشفَعُ إلّا لِمَن وَجَبَت لَهُ النارُ ؟! ثُمَّ قالَ: ما مِن أحَدٍ مِنَ الأوَّلِينَ والآخِرِينَ إلّا وهُو مُحتاجٌ إلى شَفاعَةِ محمّدٍ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يَومَ القِيامَةِ .
_source.english: A man called Abu Ayman once came to Imam al-Baqir (AS) saying, ‘O Abu Jaafar, you delude people by saying, ‘Muhammads intercession [will help you], Muhammads intercession! At this, the Imam (AS) got so angry that his face was glowering, and said, ‘Woe betide you Abu Ayman! If your belly and your private parts keep you away from sin, does that mean they delude you? You would only have to see the atrocities of the Day of Resurrection to need Muhammad (SAWA)s intercession. Woe unto you! In any case, do you think that he will only intercede for those whose punishment in the Fire is obligatory?! Then he continued, saying, ‘Every single person, from the first to the last, will need the intercession of Muhammad (SAWA) on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ثلاثةٌ يَشفَعُونَ إلى اللّهِ عَزَّوجلَّ فَيُشَفَّعُونَ: الأنبياءُ ، ثُمّ العُلَماءُ ، ثُمّ الشُّهَداءُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Three types of people have the right to intercede with Allah, and their intercession will be accepted: the prophets, then the scholars, and then the martyrs.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الشَّفاعَةُ لِلأنْبِياءِ والأوصِياءِ والمُؤمِنِينَ والمَلائكةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘[The right of] Intercession belongs to the prophets, their vicegerents, the believers and the angels.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الشُّفَعاءُ خَمسَةٌ: القُرآنُ ، والرَّحِمُ ، والأمانَةُ ، ونَبِيُّكُم ، وأهلُ بَيتِ نَبِيِّكُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are five intercessors: the Quran, consanguinity, immunity, your Prophet, and your Prophets household.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا شَفيعَ أنجَحُ مِنَ التَّوبَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is no intercessor more effective than repentance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): شافِعُ الخَلقِ العَمَلُ بِالحَقِّ ولُزومُ الصِّدقِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The intercessor for all of creation is action according to what is right and adherence to the truth.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَلُوا اللّهَ لي الوَسِيلَةَ ... فَمَن سَألَ لي الوَسيلَهَ حَلَّتْ لَهُ الشَّفاعَةُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Ask Allah through my mediation … for whoever asks through my mediation is then allowed my intercession.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الأئمّةُ مِن وُلْدِ الحُسينِ عليه السلام ، مَن أطاعَهُم فَقَد أطاعَ اللّهَ، ومَن عَصاهُم فقد عَصَى اللّهَ عز و جل ، هُم العُروَةُ الوُثقى ، وهُمُ الوَسيلَهُ إلى اللّه عز و جل .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The Imams from the progeny of al-Husayn (AS) are such that whoever obeys them has obeyed Allah, and whoever disobeys them has disobeyed Allah. They are the Firm Rope [to Allah], and they are the means of recourse to Allah.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 58, number:217

_source.chapter: The People Most Deserving of Intercession
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ أقرَبَكُم مِنّي غَداً وأوجَبَكُم عَلَيَّ شَفاعَةً: أصدَقُكُم لِساناً ، وأدّاكُم لِلأمانَةِ ، وأحسَنُكُم خُلُقاً ، وأقرَبُكُم مِنَ الناسِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the closest from among you to me tomorrow [in the Hereafter], and the most eligible of you for my intercession are those who are the most truthful from amongst you, the most conscientious at returning a trust placed in their care, the most good-natured, and the ones who have close ties with people.

_source.chapter: A Believers Right to Intercession Depends on the Extent of His Deeds
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): في المؤمنينَ مَن يَشفَعُ مِثلَ رَبِيعَةَ ومُضَرَ ، وأقَلُّ المُؤمنينَ شَفاعَةً مَن يَشفَعُ لِثَلاثِينَ إنساناً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are people from among the believers who have the right to intercession like Rabiaa and Musar. A believer has the right to intercede on behalf of at least thirty people.

_source.chapter: A Believers Right to Intercession Depends on the Extent of His Deeds
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَشفَعُ الرَّجُلُ في القَبيلَةِ ، ويَشفَعُ الرَّجُلُ لاِءهلِ البَيتِ ، ويَشفَعُ الرجُلُ لِلرَّجُلَينِ على قَدرِ عَمَلِهِ ، فذلكَ المَقامُ المَحمودُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘A man may intercede on behalf of his tribe, or for his family, or even just for two other people, depending on the extent of his deeds, for that is the Glorious Station.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا يُؤنِسَنّكَ إلّا الحقُّ ، ولا يُوحِشَنّكَ إلّا الباطلُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Only the truth will ever afford you company [as an intimate friend], and only falsehood will desert you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الاُنسُ في ثلاثٍ : في الزَّوجةِ المُوافِقَةِ، والوَلدِ البارِّ ، والصَّديقِ المُصافي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Intimacy is found in three: a compatible wife, a kind child, and a loyal friend.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الاسْتِرسالُ بالاُنسِ يُذهِبُ المَهابةَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Ridha (AS) said, ‘Being overindulgent in ones intimacy [with people] drives ones dignity away.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن خَرجَ مِن ذُلِّ المعصيةِ إلى عِزِّ الطّاعةِ آنسَهُ اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ بغَيرِ أنيسٍ ، وأعانَهُ بغيرِ مالٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When a man comes out of the humiliation of disobedience to the dignity of obedience, Allah will grant him intimacy without need for a close friend and elevate him without wealth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ انْفَردَ عنِ النّاسِ أنِسَ باللّهِ سبحانَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who isolates himself away from people will find intimacy with Allah, glory be to Him.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما مِن مؤمنٍ إلّا وقد جَعلَ اللّهُ لَهُ مِن إيمانِهِ اُنْساً يَسكُنُ إليهِ ، حتّى لو كانَ على قُلّةِ جَبلٍ لَم يَسْتَوحِشْ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah makes the faith of every single believer his own [source of] intimacy, so that he will never feel lonely even if he were to be on the top of a mountain.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن أنِسَ باللّهِ اسْتَوحَشَ مِن النّاسِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Askari (AS) said, ‘A man who finds intimacy with Allah feels lonely among people.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): احذَرُوا كُلَّ مُسكِرٍ ، فإنَّ كُلَّ مُسكِرٍ حَرامٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Every intoxicant is prohibited.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما أسكَرَ كَثيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرامٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Whatever substance intoxicates when consumed in large amounts is prohibited even in small amounts.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لعبد اللّه بن مسعود ـ: يا بنَ مسعودٍ، اِحذَر سُكرَ الخَطيئةِ ؛ فإنَّ لِلخَطيئةِ سُكراً كَسُكرِ الشَّرابِ ، بل هِي أشَدُّ سُكراً مِنهُ ، يقولُ اللّهُ تعالى: «صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ فهُم لايَرْجِعُونَ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'O Ibn Masaud, be wary of the intoxication brought about by sin, for verily the sin intoxicates just as much as alcohol if not more. Allah, most High, says, "Deaf, dumb and blind, they do not apply reason"
_source.cited_from: Quran 2:171. Makarim al-Akhlaq, volume:2, p. 352, number:266

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): السُّكرُ أربَعُ سَكراتٍ: سُكرُ الشَّرابِ ، وسُكرُ المالِ ، وسُكرُ النَّومِ ، وسُكرُ المُلكِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'There are four types of intoxication: the intoxication induced by drink, the intoxication induced by wealth, the intoxication of sleep, and the intoxication induced by power.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَنبَغِي للعاقِلِ أن يَحتَرِسَ مِن سُكرِ المالِ ، وسُكرِ القُدرَةِ ، وسُكرِ العِلمِ ، وسُكرِ المَدحِ ، وسُكرِ الشَّبابِ ، فإنَّ لِكُلِّ ذلكَ رِياحاً خَبيثةً تَسلُبُ العَقلَ وتَستَخِفُّ الوَقارَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The man of reason must be on his guard against the intoxication of wealth, of power, of knowledge, of praise and of youth, for all of these have offensive vapours about them that strip away one's reason and carry away one's dignity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سُكرُ الغَفلَةِ والغُرورِ أبعَدُ إفاقَةً مِن سُكرِ الخُمُورِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The intoxication of heedlessness and arrogance take longer to regain consciousness from than the intoxication of wines.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حَيثُما كُنتُم فَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ، فإنَّ صلاتَكُم تَبلُغُني.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Wherever you may be, invoke blessings on me for verily your blessing reaches me.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن صَلّى عَلَيَّ في كتابٍ لَم تَزَلِ الملائكَةُ تَستَغفِرُ لَهُ مادَامَ اسمِي في ذلكَ الكتابِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever invokes blessings on me, writing it on paper, the angels continue to seek forgiveness on his behalf as long as my name remains written on the paper.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ دُعاءٍ مَحجُوبٌ حتّى يُصَلَّى على النبيِّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Every supplication remains veiled until blessings are invoked on the Prophet (SAWA).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ أو الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِم الّسَلامُ): أثقَلُ ما يُوضَعُ في المِيزانِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ الصَّلاةُ على محمّدٍ وعَلى أهلِ بَيتِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The heaviest thing to be placed on the scales on the Day of Resurrection is the invocation of blessings on Muhammad and his household (AS).

_source.chapter: The Method of Invoking Blessings on the Prophet (SAWA)
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عن كَيفِيَّةِ الصَّلاةِ علَيهِ ـ: قُولُوا: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ على محمّدٍ وعلى آلِ محمَّدٍ، كما صَلَّيتَ على إبراهيمَ وعلى آلِ إبراهيمَ إنّكَ حَميدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وبارِكْ على محمدٍ وعلى آلِ محمّدٍ، كَما بارَكتَ على إبراهيمَ وعلى آلِ إبراهيمَ إنّكَ حَميدٌ مَجيدٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) when he was asked how to send blessings on him, replied, ‘Say: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as you blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham, verily you are Praiseworthy and Glorious. And send Your benediction on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad, just as you sent Your benediction on Abraham and on the family of Abraham, verily you are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الإسلامُ يَعلُو ولا يُعلى علَيهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Islam excels and cannot be surpassed by anything else.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أحسَنَ في الإسلامِ لَم يُؤاخَذْ بما عَمِلَ في الجاهليَّةِ ، ومَن أساءَ في الإسلامِ اُخِذَ بِالأوَّلِ والآخِرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who performs good acts after having embraced Islam will not be punished for anything that he did in his pre-Islamic state, whilst he who continues to commit bad after having embraced Islam will be taken to account for everything from beginning to end.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا شَرَفَ أعلى مِنَ الإسلامِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'There is no distinction higher than Islam.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ هذا الإسلامَ دِينُ اللّهِ الذي اصطَفاهُ لِنفسِهِ ، واصطَنَعَهُ على عَينِهِ ، وأصفاهُ خِيَرَةَ خَلقِهِ ، وأقامَ دَعائمَهُ على مَحَبَّتِهِ ، أذَلَّ الأديانَ بِعِزَّتِهِ ، ووَضَعَ المِلَلَ بِرَفعِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Verily this Islam is the religion of Allah, which He has chosen for Himself, which He has developed before His eyes, which He has preferred for the best of all His creatures, and whose pillars he has founded upon His love. He has abased other religions by honouring it and humiliated other creeds before its sublimity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصفِ الإسلامِ ـ: فهُو أبلَجُ المَناهِجِ ، وأوضَحُ (واضِحُ) الوَلائجِ، مُشرِفُ المَنارِ ، مُشرِقُ الجَوادِّ ، مُضِيءُ المَصابِيحِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS), in his description of Islam, said, 'It is the brightest of all paths, the clearest of all passages, with towering minarets, brightly lit highways and illuminating lamps.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المُسلمُ أخُو المُسلِم ، لا يَظلِمُهُ ولا يَشتُمُهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A Muslim is the brother of a fellow Muslim - he neither wrongs him nor insults him.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المُسلمُ أخُو المُسلمِ ، لا يَخُونُهُ ولا يَكذِبُهُ ولا يَخذُلُهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'A Muslim is the brother of a fellow Muslim - he neither betrays him nor lies to him nor deceives him.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): المُسلمُ مِرآةُ المُسلمِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The Muslim is the mirror of a fellow Muslim.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المُسلمُ مَن سَلِمَ الناسُ مِن يَدِهِ ولِسانِهِ ، والمُؤمِنُ مَنِ ائتَمَنَهُ الناسُ على أموالِهِم وأنفُسِهِم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'A Muslim is he whose hand and tongue people feel safe from, whilst a believer (mu'min) is he whom people trust with their belongings and their lives.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الإسلامُ عُريانٌ ؛ فَلِباسُهُ الحَياءُ ، وزِينَتُهُ الوَفاءُ ، ومُرُوءَتُهُ العَمَلُ الصالِحُ ، وعِمادُهُ الوَرَعُ ، ولِكُلِّ شَيءٍ أساسٌ وأساسُ الإسلامِ حُبُّنا أهلَ البَيتِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Islam is naked, and its clothing is modesty, its adornment loyalty, its valour good deeds, and its pillars piety. Everything has a foundation, and the foundation of Islam is the love for us, the ahl al-bayt (the household of the Prophet).

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أساسُ الإسلامِ حُبّي وحُبُّ أهلِ بَيتِي .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The foundation of Islam is love for me and love for my household.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قَواعِدُ الإسلامِ سَبعَةٌ: فَأوَّلُها العَقلُ وعلَيهِ بُنِيَ الصَّبرُ ، والثاني: صَونُ العِرضِ وصِدقُ اللَّهجَةِ ، والثالِثَةُ: تِلاوَةُ القُرآنِ على جِهَتِهِ ، والرابِعَةُ: الحُبُّ في اللّهِ والبُغضُ في اللّهِ ، والخامِسةُ: حَقُّ آلِ محمّدٍ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ومَعرِفَةُ وَلايَتِهِم ، والسادِسَةُ: حَقُّ الإخوانِ والمُحاماةُ علَيهِم ، والسّابِعَةُ: مُجاوَرَةُ الناسِ بالحُسنى .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Islam has seven fundamentals: the first is reason, on which perseverance is founded. The second is maintenance of one's honour and honest speech. The third is proper recitation of the Qur'an. The fourth is to love for the sake of Allah and to hate for the sake of Allah. The fifth is the right due to the household of the Prophet (SAWA) and their guardianship. The sixth is the right of one's fellow brothers and their protection. The seventh is close contact with people through fair means.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بُنِيَ الإسلامُ على خَمسَةِ دَعائمَ: إقامِ الصَّلاةِ ، وإيتاءِ الزَّكاةِ ، وصَومِ شَهرِ رَمَضانَ ، وحَجِّ البَيتِ الحَرامِ ، والوَلايَةِ لَنا أهلَ البَيتِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Islam has been founded on five pillars: the establishment of prayer, the giving of the alms-tax, the fast of the month of Ramazan, the pilgrimage to the Sanctified House, and [the acknowledgment of] our guardianship, the ahl al-bayt.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ الإمامَةَ اُسُ الإسلامِ النامي، وفَرعُهُ السامي .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, 'Verily Imama (divinely appointed leadership of the twelve Imams) is the ever-growing root of Islam as well as its lofty branch.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الإسلامُ أن تُسلِمَ قَلبَكَ ويَسلَمَ المُسلمونَ مِن لِسانِكَ ويَدِكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Islam is that you submit your heart [to Allah], and that all Muslims feels safe from your tongue and your hand.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أصبَحَ لا يَهتَمُّ بِاُمورِ المُسلمينَ فلَيسَ بمُسلمٍ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who wakes up in the morning unconcerned about the situations of fellow Muslims is not a Muslim.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الإسلامُ هُو التسليمُ ، والتسليمُ هُو اليَقينُ ، واليَقينُ هُو التصديقُ ، والتصديقُ هُو الإقرارُ، والإقرارُ هُو الأداءُ ، والأداءُ هُو العَملُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Verily Islam is submission, and submission is conviction, and conviction is certification of something, and certification is attestation, and attestation of something is fulfilment of it, and fulfilment is the performance of required acts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): جانِبُوا الخِيانةَ ، فإنّها مُجانَبَةُ الإسلامِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Repel treachery, for verily it repels Islam.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أعانَ على مُسلمٍ فقد بَرِئَ مِنَ الإسلامِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever aids and abets wrongdoing towards a fellow Muslim is not a Muslim.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لرجُلٍ شاميٍّ سَألَهُ عن مَسائلَ ، فلَمّا أجابَهُ قالَ : أسلَمتُ للّهِ الساعَةَ : بَل آمَنتَ بِاللّه الساعَةَ ، إنَّ الإسلامَ قبلَ الإيمانِ وعلَيهِ يَتوارَثُونَ ويَتَناكَحُونَ ، والإيمانُ علَيهِ يُثابُونَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) answered some questions that a Syrian man had come to ask him, after which the latter said, 'I am a Muslim right now. Imam said, 'No, rather you have faith right now, for Islam comes before faith [i.e. you were already a Muslim], and is the means by which people inherit each other and marry each other, whereas faith is the means by which they are rewarded.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الإسلامُ يُحقَنُ بهِ الدَّمُ وتُؤَدّى بهِ الأمانَةُ ، وتُستَحَلُّ به الفُروجُ ، والثَّوابُ على الإيمانِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Islam is that through which life is spared, goods are entrusted, and women become lawful [through marriage], whereas faith is that which incurs reward.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : قالَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ لموسى بنِ عِمرانَ : إنَّ الحاسِدَ ساخِطٌ لنِعَمي ، صادٌّ لقِسْمي الّذي قَسَمْتُ بينَ عِبادي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, said to Moses son of Amran (AS) [known in the Arabic tradition as Aimran], ‘Verily the jealous is discontented with My bounties, and wards off the shares I have apportioned to My servants.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَسدُ حَبْسُ الرُّوحِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Jealousy is the spirits imprisonment.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَسدُ شَرُّ الأمْراضِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Jealousy is the worst disease.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رأسُ الرَّذائلِ الحَسدُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The chief of vices is jealousy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : للّهِ دَرُّ الحَسدِ ما أعْدَلَهُ ! بَدأَ بصاحِبِهِ فقَتلَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘How capable jealousy is! And how just it is, that it starts off with its perpetrator and ends up killing him!
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:1, p. 316

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ثَمرَةُ الحَسدِ شَقاءُ الدُّنيا والآخِرَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fruit of jealousy is the misery of this world and the Hereafter.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحاسِدُ يَرى أنَّ زَوالَ النِّعمَةِ عَمَّن يَحسُدُهُ نِعْمَةٌ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The jealous one sees a loss for the one he is jealous of as a gain for himself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما رَأيتُ ظالِما أشْبَهَ بمَظلومٍ مِن الحاسِدِ : نَفَسٌ دائمٌ ، وقَلبٌ هائمٌ ، وحُزنٌ لازمٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘I have not seen a wrong-doer resemble a wronged person more than the jealous one: he has an exhausted spirit, a wandering heart, and an inherent sorrow.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : حَسْبُ الحاسِدِ ما يَلْقى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘That which he suffers is [torment] enough for the jealous one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَسودُ كثيرُ الحَسَراتِ ، مُتضَاعَفُ السَّيّئاتِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The jealous one has many regrets, and his vices are manifold.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَسودُ لا يَسودُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The jealous one can never rule.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : اسْتَعينوا على قَضاءِ حَوائجِكُم بالكِتْمانِ ، فإنَّ كُلَّ ذي نِعمَةٍ مَحسودٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Seek the assistance of secrecy in fulfilling your needs, for every prosperous person is envied.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:1, p. 316

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ الحَسَد لَيَأكُلُ الإيمانَ كما تَأكُلُ النّارُ الحَطَبَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Jealousy consumes faith like fire consumes dry wood.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إيّاكُم أنْ يَحْسُدَ بَعضُكُم بَعْضا ؛ فإنَّ الكُفْرَ أصلُهُ الحَسدُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Beware of being jealous of one another, for the origin of disbelief is jealousy.

_source.chapter: The Signs of the Jealous Person
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قالَ لُقمانُ لابنِهِ : للحاسِدِ ثَلاثُ عَلاماتٍ : يَغْتابُ إذا غابَ ، ويَتَملّقُ إذا شَهِدَ ، ويَشْمَتُ بالمُصيبَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Luqman told his son, ‘There are three signs of the jealous person: he backbites someone in his absence, flatters him in his presence, and rejoices at the misery of others.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : علَيكُم بالجِدِّ والاجْتِهادِ ، والتّأهُّبِ والاسْتِعدادِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘You must adopt earnestsness, diligence, preparedness and willingness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : طاعَةُ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ لا يَحُوزُها إلّامَن بَذَلَ الجِدَّ ، واسْتَفْرَغَ الجُهْدَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Obedience to Allah cannot be attained except by one who possesses earnestness and exerts himself to the utmost.
